theme: Theme 4: Anisotropy evaluation & classification including Bianchi spaces

claim_firewall_status.declaration: All evaluations represent algebraic constraint variety distances d_{V_m}(theta_K) under kinematic projections. No native Bianchi Boltzmann ODE solver was executed. No specific Bianchi family is identified.

scalar_x_C_cancellation_ablation.theorem: STAT-BLIND-XC: Codimension-1 Cancellation Kernel of Scalar Comparator
scalar_x_C_cancellation_ablation.description: A non-trivial physical spacetime with cosmic shear and relativistic tilt can produce x_C = 0 identically when spatial curvature is slightly open (-2.11e-4), well within 0.15-sigma of DESI DR2 BAO.

rotating_rest_bundle_gauss_r191a.interpretation: Non-integrable observer rest space u^perp does not admit 3-surfaces; rest-bundle Gauss curvature has an exact -2 omega^2 gap relative to naive slice curvature.

hypersurface_normal_n_frame.frobenius_theorem: Holds identically; dt is an exact 1-form, hence slice normal n_a = -N dt is strictly vorticity-free (omega[n] = 0).

matter_comoving_u_frame.physical_meaning: Tilted dust flow with rapidity beta_RM in sheared spacetime develops non-zero vorticity omega[u] > 0, producing an irrecoverable lower-endpoint gap on the slice normal.

V0_FLRW.description: Standard isotropic FLRW (zero shear, zero tilt, zero vorticity, flat)
V0_FLRW.verdict_reason: Cosmic shear (4.1-sigma) and matter-radiation tilt (5.7-sigma) strongly reject isotropic FLRW at 8.2-sigma joint tension.

V1_BIANCHI_I_UNTILTED.verdict_reason: Matter-radiation tilt (5.7-sigma) rules out untilted Bianchi I at 5.7-sigma tension.

V2_BIANCHI_V_UNTILTED.description: Bianchi Type V orthogonal/untilted (isotropic negative spatial curvature)
V2_BIANCHI_V_UNTILTED.verdict_reason: Matter tilt (5.7-sigma) rules out untilted Bianchi V.

V3_BIANCHI_VII0_UNTILTED.description: Bianchi Type VII_0 orthogonal/untilted (flat spiral shear waves)
V3_BIANCHI_VII0_UNTILTED.verdict_reason: Matter tilt rules out untilted VII_0.

V4_BIANCHI_VIIH_UNTILTED.description: Bianchi Type VII_h orthogonal/untilted (standard open spiral model)
V4_BIANCHI_VIIH_UNTILTED.verdict_reason: Untilted VII_h cannot explain matter-radiation drift dipole.

V5_KING_ELLIS_TILTED_CLASS_B.description: King-Ellis tilted dynamics in Class B (Bianchi V or VII_h with non-geodesic matter tilt)
V5_KING_ELLIS_TILTED_CLASS_B.verdict_reason: Kinematic state (shear, tilt, open curvature) satisfies all 1+3 King-Ellis constraint equations within 0.44-sigma.

V6_KING_ELLIS_TILTED_CLASS_A_MULTIFLUID.description: King-Ellis tilted dynamics in Class A (Bianchi I multi-fluid drift / antipodal pairs)
V6_KING_ELLIS_TILTED_CLASS_A_MULTIFLUID.verdict_reason: Flat background DeltaOmega_k = 0 is consistent with DESI BAO at 0.44-sigma; multi-fluid tilt satisfies momentum constraint.

V7_LRS_DEGENERATION_STRATUM.description: Locally Rotationally Symmetric (LRS) stratum: uniaxial shear degeneration
V7_LRS_DEGENERATION_STRATUM.verdict_reason: Uniaxial shear cannot be ruled out; discriminant residual is within 1.18-sigma of zero.

classification_summary.crucial_distinction: Algebraic compatibility with King-Ellis tilted dynamics does NOT identify the Bianchi family (Class A vs Class B remains indistinguishable at leading kinematic order due to the Omega_k degeneracy). Both Class A and Class B admit compatible tilted realizations.
